actions.action: Lock the session instead of deleting tickets
actions.mechanism: Separate screen privacy from cart retention using a visitor-chosen local resume code, without an account.
actions.implementation: Before ticket selection, establish a code. At inactivity, show only Resume and Start new; retain encrypted carts locally for 30 minutes.
actions.check: Interrupt a ten-minute offline session; verify correct-code recovery, rate-limited incorrect attempts, and no previous selections through Start new or Back.
actions.risk: Forgotten codes prevent recovery; short codes need attempt limits.

actions.action: Provide an untimed, selection-free reading mode
actions.mechanism: Let visitors read generic explanations indefinitely while their selected tickets remain locked and invisible.
actions.implementation: Add Read at your pace on every step. Hide selections, clear personalized screen-reader output, and require the resume code to return.
actions.check: Compare timed screens with reading mode: count reconstruction events and code entries; staged handoffs must expose no selections visually or audibly.
actions.risk: Visitors may overlook reading mode; private review still needs locking.

actions.action: Discard personal details separately from ticket choices
actions.mechanism: Minimize abandoned sensitive data without forcing visitors to rebuild their non-identifying ticket selections.
actions.implementation: Collect details only when necessary near checkout; erase them on locking or Start new. Persist only the coded cart offline; require explicit purchase confirmation.
actions.check: Enter distinctive test details, then interrupt offline. Verify recovery preserves tickets but exposes no details through screens, Back, screen reader, or logs.
actions.risk: Visitors must re-enter cleared details; unsupported offline payments must remain explicitly pending.
